# parameter value

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:parameterValue`](gmeow-parameterValue.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/parameterValue>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The bound literal value. Use [`gmeow:parameterEntity`](gmeow-parameterEntity.md) for IRI-valued bindings; a parameter carries exactly one of the two (SHACL).

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:ConditionParameter`](../classes/gmeow-ConditionParameter.md) -> `?`; functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:parameterValue`](gmeow-parameterValue.md) from [`gmeow:ConditionParameter`](../classes/gmeow-ConditionParameter.md) to `?` when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:ConditionParameter`](../classes/gmeow-ConditionParameter.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to bind a parameter to a literal value.

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it for an IRI-valued binding (that is [`gmeow:parameterEntity`](gmeow-parameterEntity.md)) and avoid carrying both — a parameter holds exactly one of the two (SHACL).

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:parameterValue`](gmeow-parameterValue.md) once per literal-valued [`gmeow:ConditionParameter`](../classes/gmeow-ConditionParameter.md); switch to [`gmeow:parameterEntity`](gmeow-parameterEntity.md) when the binding is an entity.

### Examples

- ex:p1 [`gmeow:parameterValue`](gmeow-parameterValue.md) "0.8".
